original_test_intent: Immediately restart the intended running SUT through BMC Web UI and prove the approved abrupt restart, subsequent boot readiness and lack of unexpected platform errors.
original_method: Verify target/on state and no active writes or firmware operation, preserve baseline, issue one documented immediate-restart action, monitor interruption, chassis/console/boot and compare recovered platform health.
manual_activity: The owner approves abrupt restart and its data/service risk, validates the safety gate and defines boot recovery; an operator supervises the full transition.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC and verified on state
Restart/boot signals, timeout, final health and event oracle
safety_requirements: Verify exact target and action semantics
Do not substitute fan reads, orderly restart, power off or AC cycle
Stop on uncertain state or boot anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify approval, target and safety gates
Monitor console, chassis, POST, OS and storage
Compare recovered health and events without retry, recovery autonomy or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: front-fan sensor listing belongs to the duplicate row and cannot exercise an immediate restart.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented protected immediate-restart control once and wait on authoritative boot and health signals.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Immediate restart, no-error criteria, scripts and 1/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit data-safety, secret handling, boot readiness and no-retry recovery boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static fan data cannot establish interruption or recovered boot state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt restart may corrupt data or interrupt firmware and can leave the host unbootable.

project_override_considerations: An API alternative must match the documented immediate-restart semantics. Graceful restart, power-off and AC/reset actions are separate coverage.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/on state and safety assessment
Abrupt transition, console, chassis and boot timeline
New-event comparison, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1512 consistently defines immediate restart. The same-code front-fan row is isolated as a distinct variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Approval, safe state, supported control and boot oracle are finite inputs, so attended conditional execution is feasible.

review_improvement: Rejects copied fan telemetry and defines the abrupt one-request restart with pre-action data protection and verified boot recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The defining risk is abrupt interruption before normal OS quiescence. Automation can issue and observe the request, but cannot accept the data-loss risk or autonomously repeat/recover a failed boot.
